Thirukkural (also known as the Kural) is one of the most important works in the Tamil language consisting of 1330 couplets or Kurals. It was authored by Thiruvalluvar.

Thirukkural is structured into 133 chapters, each containing 10 couplets, for a total of 1330 couplets. The 133 chapters are grouped into three sections:
	•	(Arathupaal ) Needs (1-38)
	•	(Porutpaal ) Wealth (39-108)
	•	(Kamathupaal) Love (109-133)
A couplet or Kural consists of seven cirs, with four cirs on the first line and three on the second. A cir is a single or a combination of more than one Tamil word.
